playstyle: Unconventional and evasive. Control neutral with great jabs, mid pokes (b+4, df+1) and many lows, dodge with evasive moves, and mix the opponent up from Kenpo (KNP), Shifting Clouds (STC) and back-turned. Wavu notes he is weak to sidesteps and sidewalks to his left.

stances.name: Kenpo
stances.note: KNP.2 is an i14 Heat Engager; KNP.3 tornadoes (+77a).

stances.name: Shifting Clouds
stances.note: STC.3 is a homing high that is +6 on block.

stances.name: Back-turned
stances.entry: SS.2 and other moves transition to BT
stances.note: BT.2 is a Heat Engager; Wavu lists BT.3 and BT.d+3 as combo follow-ups.

stances.name: Crouch Dash
stances.note: CD.2 tornadoes; CD+1+2 is +0c on block.
